Commentary.Commentary: We are back for Afghanistan's second innings. The Zimbabwe players are out in the middle. Abdul Malik and Ibrahim Zadran will open the innings for Afghanistan. Blessing Muzarabani will start the proceedings for Zimbabwe.

Now Afghanistan have to bat really well. Their first aim will be to erase the deficit without losing many wickets. They will be aiming to give Zimbabwe a target of around 200. The wicket is nice so they would want their batters to cash in. Zimbabwe, on the other hand, would want to pick wickets at regular intervals as they know they would be batting last and it won't be easy on this wicket.

For Afghanistan, Hamza was the pick of the bowlers with a 6-fer. He though was the only one who actually bowled well. The others were quite wayward and bowled far too many bad balls. Had all of them bowled well, the lead would have well been under 100.

So Afghanistan have made quick work of the last two wickets after the Lunch break but after Williams got to his ton. That was probably what all the Zimbabwe side were waiting for after the break. It is because of him his side is ahead in the game. Yes, there was support from a few other batters but he was the mainstay.

We are all set to begin Day 2. The Afghanistan players are out in the middle. Sean Williams and Ryan Burl will resume their innings for Zimbabwe. Zahir Khan will start the proceedings for Afghanistan for Day 2.

Hello and welcome to Day 2 of the first Test between Afghanistan and Zimbabwe. The game has moved at a really good pace so far with the African minnows having their noses ahead at the moment. They have the slenderest of leads at the moment but have five wickets in the kitty. Zimbabwe would look to stretch it to at least 100. Afghanistan, on the other hand, will hope they can take wickets quickly and keep the lead under 50. An interesting first session awaits.
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

So that is it from Day 1! It has been a happy comeback to the longest format for Zimbabwe but a nightmare one for Afghanistan. The tourists have taken a lead of 2 runs and have 5 wickets in hand with their skipper still out in the middle. They will look to expand their lead. Afghanistan will try to get through the wickets as quickly as possible and keep the deficit to a minimal. Join us for Day 2 of the first Test on Wednesday, 3rd March. The action begins at 0930 local (0530 GMT). We hope to see you then. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Hamza impressed with his bowling for Afghanistan, finishing the day with a 4-fer. But that was not enough for the hosts as Zimbabwe have gone past their total. It was just not Afghanistan's day as, towards the end of the day, they also lost their only pacer in this game, Yamin Ahmadzai to injury. Asghar Afghan will hope that he recovers well and is fit enough to bowl on Day 2! A lot of work for the Asian side to do if they are to make a comeback in this game.

After a torrid batting show, Afghanistan needed their bowlers to do the damage control job. The bowlers gave it their all and put their side back in the game when they left the tourists reeling at 38/4. But a solid 71-run stand between Raza and Williams steadied the ship. Hamza though managed to get rid of the former before the end of day's play. The skipper did not let that affect him as he continued his merry way and got to his fifty and ensured that the deficit is wiped out.

It was a day that clearly belonged to Zimbabwe. The visitors lost the toss and were asked to bowl. The pace duo of Blessing Muzarabani and Victor Nyauchi wrecked havoc as the pair grabbed 7 wickets amongst themselves with Blessing finishing with a 4-fer. That effort saw Afghanistan bundle out for a paltry score of 131!

A good day of Test cricket between the two sides that have not played any Test cricket prior to this for more than a year. It was a day that clearly belonged to the bowlers as the batters from both sides have struggled under the challenge. 15 wickets fell but Sean Williams has shown how to bat and the skipper's fifty sees the visitors finishing the day well on top.

OUT! LBW! Wesley Madhevere departs for a golden duck and Hamza is on a hat-trick. Quicker and straighter ball. It pitches on middle and comes on quicker. Madhevere looks to defend but misses the straighter one and misreads the pace of the ball. He is late to get his bat down in time. The ball hits him on the pad, the Afghanistan players are sure they have their man and go up in a confident appeal. The umpire is in agreement and raises the finger. From looking decent at 38/2 the tourists are now in a state of bother at 38/4!
Wesley Madhevere is the new batsman in.

OUT! LBW! Beautifully bowled and Hamza gets his second of the innings. He has bowled brilliantly and deserves this. The round arm action of Amir Hamza doing the trick here and how many times have we seen a wicket fall right after the break? Hamza tosses it up nicely on off. The ball skids and turns. Masvaure looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the back pad. An appeal follows and the umpire raises the dreaded finger.
Loopy delivery on middle, Masvaure looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals for lbw but the umpire shakes his head.
Floated ball on middle, Masvaure flicks it towards the leg side.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Williams flicks it through square leg for a single.

DRINKS! Afghanistan have managed to scalp two wickets but will be looking to add a couple more before the end of the day's play. Zimbabwe trail now by just another 94 runs and they will be hoping that their skipper, Sean Williams and Prince Masvaure can see the remaining of the day and reduce the deficit. Amir Hamza is back on.
Short around off, Masvaure punches it to cover.

Appeal for a caught behind but the umpire is unmoved. Arm ball outside off, Prince Masvaure looks to defend but the ball goes closely past the outside edge. There is a confident appeal from the Afghanistan players as there is a sound. There is a confident appeal from the Afghanistan players but the umpire is unmoved.

INSIDE EDGE AND FOUR! What a ripper first up! Flighted delivery on middle and off, it turns and spins back in. Williams looks to push it away from his body but the ball takes the inside edge. It goes fine down the leg side and to the fine leg fence. The Zimbabwe skipper is off the mark but in a nervy fashion.
Who will walk out at number 4? It will be the skipper, Sean Williams!

Zimbabwe needed a solid start but they have not got that so far. 2 down already. Hamza floats one on off, Musakanda looks to defend but the ball beats his defenses and goes onto hit the pole.

OUT! BOWLED! What a peach from Yamin Ahmadzai! Top class delivery from the Afghan pacer and they have an early strike. Just what the doctor ordered! Kasuza walks back without troubling the scorers. Yamin goes full and pitches it on middle. Kevin Kasuza looks to defend it to the on side and commits to it. The ball though shapes away, beats the outside edge, and rattles the middle and off pole. The awful sound of timber is what Kasuza hears. Perfect start for Afghanistan.
Good length ball outside off and shaping away. Kasuza leaves it alone.
FOUR LEG BYES! Yamin Ahmadzai misses his line and bowls on the pads. Kasuza looks to flick but the ball kisses his thigh pad and goes fine down the leg side to the fine leg fence.
Prince and Zimbabwe are off the mark straightaway! Ahmadzai starts with a fuller ball on middle. It comes back in a bit to the left-hander. Masvaure flicks it with the swing to fine leg for a single.
